summary.semantic: Planned → verified Actual: all four planned D02 quality capabilities are realized. Lightweight Gate stayed bounded; Structural Dependency Health finalized five high-confidence bad-edge rules; Entropy Hygiene contracted to production-root reachability after Knip/unused-symbol proof was rejected; Applicable Checks finalized host-derived Git-visible candidate identity, environment-aware check identity, exact execution/admission, and non-recursive exact PASS reuse. No Registry, Planner, Evidence Platform, cache, snapshot DB, or smart selection was introduced.
summary.presentation: Planned and Actual share the same component IDs and primary geometry. Planned labels/tags express intent; Actual replaces them with verified scope and repository source evidence, making semantic contraction and realized details visible without a topology rewrite.
